title: The Date You Didn't Set: The System-Prompt Date as a Hidden Variable in LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31254v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The system prompt of many instruction-tuned models carries a date, usually today's, filled in automatically for conversational and agentic requests alike, so an unchanged evaluation can send a different prompt each day. In this paper, we explore how much this hidden input changes evaluation outcomes. Across six instruction-tuned models and four benchmarks, with prompts, decoding, and configuration fixed, every model is affected: two plausible dates (2024--2026) switch a median $6.6\%$ of test items between correct and incorrect. Even rerunning the evaluation one day later flips about as many items as changing the batch size, although nothing in the setup was changed. In addition, using a grammar-constrained variant of Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) to search dates of any year, we find dates that cost the Llama-3.x models up to $36.5$ points of held-out accuracy. translated_title: 你未曾设置的日期：系统提示日期作为大语言模型评估中的隐藏变量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.31254v1 Announce Type: cross 摘要：许多经过指令微调的模型的系统提示中都带有日期，通常是今天的日期，无论是对话请求还是智能体请求都会自动填入，因此即使评估本身没有变化，每天发送的提示也可能不同。本文探讨了这一隐藏输入会在多大程度上改变评估结果。在六个指令微调模型和四个基准测试上，即使提示、解码和配置全部固定，每个模型都受到影响：两个合理的日期（2024–2026年）会使中位数6.6%的测试项在正确与错误之间翻转。即使仅仅把评估推迟一天再运行，翻转的题目数量也与改变批处理规模相当，而实验设置中没有任何东西被改动。此外，利用语法约束的贪心坐标梯度（GCG）变体搜索任意年份的日期，我们发现某些日期会使Llama-3.x模型在保留集上的准确率损失高达36.5分。除了准确率之外，切换到另一个合理日期还会改变LLM裁判的（判决结果）……
tldr: 本文揭示系统提示中自动填入的日期是LLM评估中被忽视的隐藏变量：仅改变日期就会使中位数6.6%的基准题目翻转正误，在对抗性搜索下甚至使模型准确率损失高达36.5分，因此评估时必须固定并报告系统提示日期。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the auto-filled date in system prompts is a hidden variable in LLM evaluation—merely changing it flips a median of 6.6% of benchmark items and, under grammar-constrained GCG search, costs up to 36.5 accuracy points, so evaluations must fix and report the system-prompt date.
